crossRefs.note: “How can I pardon you? Your children have forsaken me, and sworn by what are no gods. When I had fed them to the full…
They were as fed horses roaming at large. Everyone neighed after his neighbor’s wife.
Will you steal, murder, commit adultery, swear falsely, burn incense to Baal, and walk after other gods that you have…
Oh that I had in the wilderness a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my people, and go from them! For…
Slanderous men have been in you to shed blood. In you they have eaten on the mountains. They have committed lewdness…
There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes…
Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells in it will waste away, with all living things in her, even the…
I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers…
Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral…
nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.
Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,
Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and…
You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever…
Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land; for everyone who steals shall…
I will cause it to go out,” says Yahweh of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house…
for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing…
But you, Yahweh, know me. You see me, and test my heart toward you. Pull them out like sheep for the slaughter, and…
How long will the land mourn, and the herbs of the whole country wither? Because of the wickedness of those who dwell…
“Judah mourns, and its gates languish. They sit in black on the ground. The cry of Jerusalem goes up.
She weeps bitterly in the night. Her tears are on her cheeks. Among all her lovers she has no one to comfort her. All…
The field is laid waste. The land mourns, for the grain is destroyed, The new wine has dried up, and the oil languishes.
I will weep and wail for the mountains, and lament for the pastures of the wilderness, because they are burned up, so…
and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of…

translations.web: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of the curse the land mourns. The pastures of the wilderness have dried up. Their course is evil, and their might is not right;
translations.bsb: For the land is full of adulterers— because of the curse, the land mourns and the pastures of the wilderness have dried up— their course is evil and their power is misused.
